newsitem.title: UK: OECD end Dec distillate stocks up 12 mln bls on yr.
newsitem.headline: OECD end Dec distillate stocks up 12 mln bls on yr.

text.p: Oil industry stocks of distillates in countries of the Organisation of Co-operation and Development (OECD) were not drawn during in December last year for the first time since 1990, said the International Energy Agency (IEA) on Friday.

Distillates stocks, which include vital winter heating oil, stood 12 million barrels higher that a year earlier following a 19 month period during which end of month stocks were consistently lower than a year before, the IEA said in its latest Monthly Oil Market Report.
Total oil industry stocks fell by just 1.3 million barrels per day (bpd) in December which contrasts with a much faster 2.7 million bpd draw in December 1995.
Due to the relatively slow stock draw, the shortfall in stocks versus a year earlier was reduced to only 28 million barrels, the lowest end of month shortfall in July 1995.

The shortfall in stocks continued to be concentrated in North America where stocks were 34 million barrels lower compared with an increase on 12 million barrels in the Pacific and a six million barrel fall in Europe.
